reviews.title: Monthly subscription
reviews.text:
30 day free trial and then you have to pay a subscription to use YOUR radio. 

And no they do NOT have all the station. I looked for “Black Gospel radio” and nothing. 

Terrible app

reviews.title: No good, will wait for an alternative
reviews.text:
After downloading, everything is disabled so you can’t use the demo  so I ‘subscribed’, apparently then you get a free month woohoo!
Went to set up the first Bose SoundTouch system - yup, didn’t work, tried again, yup, didn’t work again……tried again numerous times and yup, still didn’t work.
Unsubscribed and removed.
